The above-referenced contract is modified as set forth in the following, and these
amendments and modifications of the plans and specifications are agreed to by the parties.All
other aspects of the original agreement remain unchanged and in full force andeffect.
1.Description of Changes
This contract modification provides for DHM Design Corporation(*DHM") to pay for its
construction administration tasksfor the Civic Center Commons(CCC)Project.Thiswork was
noted in the original D HM contract Exhibit Cwork taskunder“Proposal Notes and Omissions”
as additional to the proposed work scope and budget and, at that time, the amount was unknown.
Wenow have thework scope and $20,587.50 cost estimate from San Engineering, the structural
steel consultant, and are seeking this contract modification to pay for those services. This San
Engineering work scope and budget is detailed in Exhibit A, attached hereto and incorporated
herein as if fully set forth.
This contract modification also reimburses the DHM Contract Administration Task 4 for
Administration, exactscope of theworkis detailed in Exhibit B, attached hereto and incorporated
herein as if fully set forth.
This contract modification also pays DHM Design to prepare for the City's use both hard
copy and digital graphic images of the CCCProject as it will appear per the 100% construction
drawings. This work scope and $13,680 budget is detailed in Exhibit C, attached hereto and
incorporated here in as if fully set forth.
I1.New Contract Items
services for the Civic Center Commons Project. These services are more particularly described in
Exhibit A.
DHM Design shall provide graphic images of theflood control and park elements of the
CCC Project as they are proposed in the 100% construction drawings. The City will use these
images for public information in various media formats. These services are more particularly
described in Exhibit C.

storm water conveyance route has changed since the original design and budget estimate
when the CCC project was connected to the26th Street storm water conveyance system.

order to include an additional$20,587.50in the D HM contract.This amount would be
funded54%by the FEMAPre-Disaster Mitigation Grant No.14FEMA-CHE-PD-PDCH14,
22% would be reimbursed by the City's Wyoming State Loan& Investment Board (SLIB)

Civic Center Commons Project.
